value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Each journal contains one target. Current owner field is its expected revision; retry recomputes from a fresh read. Immutable source records are revalidated before dependent owner work. Exhaustive package and SDK transition crash/interleaving cases are running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PR #1 source-admission class: captured hypothesis and observation source revisions are now held with SDK native item leases and fenced through the owner field CAS. Source changes at pre-admission boundaries refuse with conflict and leave matrix/revision unchanged; post-admission edits serialize later. Revert proof: bypassing fenced revision validation makes the record-written edit regression fail with missing expected rejection. All 9 behavioral revert proofs passed and restored source bytes exactly.

value.text: CI run 40204094375 passed 183/183 tests on both Node 22 and 26, but strict coverage reported one unmeasured async cleanup path (99.81% branches). Focused source coverage confirms that cleanup path is measured; thresholds remain 100 in all dimensions.

value.text: Round-3 review: remove source preparation writes, validate owner/source invariants before effects, and use one SDK multi-item transaction per command. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Atomic command design: source plans stay in memory. A single commitItemMutations batch applies the owner CAS first and every required native create; preview validates the whole proposed batch. Source leases are acquired inside the SDK workspace writer and retained through every batch step. Native read sets are validated before semantic checks, before the batch and inside prepared. The expanded tests exposed cached committed journals bypassing transition hooks; fresh invocation transaction identities now prevent adopting a peer's terminal plan, while deterministic native intent ids still converge after crashes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final recorded model execution via pm test --run --only-last passes 3/3 seeds (24301, 12648430, 720251025), zero failures/skips. Each seed executes 28 commands; total 84 commands, 87 checked states including initial snapshots, and all 42 combinations of six peer edit classes with seven package boundaries. The independent model checks current native images, live item ids, exact owner state, matrix witnesses, next requests, conclusion validity, bounded resumes, append-only histories and byte-identical refusals. Peer edits cover type, parent, payload, provenance, deletion and owner revisions. The fresh-record combined record-read conflict and changed-provenance conclusion cases pass. The 1312-case ordered pair suite now creates its observe/add records inside each tested invocation rather than pre-materializing them; full PR CI will verify it and all unchanged release thresholds. Twelve implementation-only revert proofs are recorded on the records item. All work remains in progress for orchestrator review; claims are released before handoff.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Post-push inspection identified an outdated boundary-matrix oracle: owner-read now validates before semantic decisions, so a source edit at record-read correctly refuses before an admission-ready peer action. The old harness incorrectly requires all prewrite boundaries and waits until admission-ready to capture peer bytes. Updating the oracle to assert the exact reachable prefix and to verify bytes before every prewrite seam, then save only the peer/completed-commit checkpoint. This strengthens detection of premature package writes while permitting required short-circuit behavior; no production behavior or threshold changes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The new early-refusal regression passes 1/1 both directly and through pm test. It proves a record-read source edit reaches only record-read, plan-ready and owner-read, returns typed conflict, skips the later peer action, and leaves durable bytes equal to the peer checkpoint. Matrix callbacks now verify durable byte equality before every prewrite boundary and record the exact reachable prefix on conflict. CI logs on the prior head confirm stale checkpoint assertions, not an extra product write. Typecheck, lint and zero duplication (0/3421 lines) pass after the oracle correction. Production code is unchanged from the atomic/source-validity commit.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Recovery model passes all 68 boundary/edit cases plus its parent assertion: six mutating paths, every prepared/applied/recorded/committing/committed journal boundary, then unrelated and conflicting edits. Unrelated edits preserve their native changes and converge; conflicting declarations refuse without durable tracker changes. Package-owned runtime lineage uses public SDK lease, atomic-write and read primitives, records superseded or currently-satisfied attempts, and never reads, deletes or rewrites SDK journals. Native attempt ids bind stable intent, all captured item/schema preconditions and fresh invocation entropy. Upstream pm-cli#1597 remains the journal status/abandon/replan API gap.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Recovery uses current SDK records and fresh transaction identities containing canonical intent, all captured owner/source versions, schema signature and invocation entropy. A changed precondition cannot collide with an old journal plan; package-owned runtime lineage supersedes prior validated attempts, and verified native no-ops mark pending intents satisfied. SDK journals are never read, abandoned or rewritten. Public journal lifecycle APIs remain unavailable (unbraind/pm-cli#1597). The 68 native journal-boundary and unrelated/conflicting edit cases pass.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof, recovery class (issue 6): replacing the revision-bound transaction id with an intent-only id makes the interrupted first-attachment retry fail assert.doesNotReject after an unrelated owner edit. Both proofs alter implementation only in a disposable copy and restore exact bytes; the live implementation preserves the peer title, initializes once, and subsequent identical calls write nothing. No SDK journal files are read or changed; see unbraind/pm-cli#1597.
